card.name: The word also after a contrast
card.fires_on: The word "also" placed right after a subject or auxiliary verb (have, has, is, but, rates) in a second clause that adds to or contrasts with a first statement. Mostly in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Also after have/has
modes.description: "also" follows have or has in a clause saying an event has also been reported or resulted.
modes.example: these events have<< also>> been reported at or below the recommended infusion

modes.label: Also after a noun or pronoun
modes.description: "also" follows a subject such as rates, drugs, or we, after a however or but clause.
modes.example: adverse event rates<< also>> increase. Doses beyond 34

card.plain: It marks the word "also" when a sentence adds a further effect or fact after a first point, often after "however" or "but".
